title: DR1 introduces the tasks under a 'Notification tasklist' heading; the frontend runs straight from the commodity summary into the first task group with nothing to say the list has started.

finding.frontend: Below the two commodity cards the frontend goes directly to '1. About the consignment' (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/template.njk:26-35). The rendered page has two kinds of second-level heading and nothing distinguishing them: 'Your commodities' and each of the six group captions are all h2. Nothing on the page tells the user that what follows the summary is the list of tasks.
finding.prototype: DR1 puts the task list in its own section under a second-level heading, 'Notification tasklist', matching the 'Your commodities' heading above it, and drops the six group captions to third-level headings underneath it (app/views/notification-hub.html:52-58). A user reading down the page, or listening to it, meets two named sections — the summary and the task list — with the numbered groups sitting inside the second.
finding.difference: Add a 'Notification tasklist' heading between the commodity summary and the first group, at the same level as 'Your commodities', and demote the six group captions one level so they sit under it. Copy and heading levels only; the groups and their contents do not move.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a 'Notification tasklist' heading already rendered on the frontend hub, or finding DR1's group captions at the same heading level as 'Your commodities'.
